# Statuses of the cases of the universe test (universe_test.go): case, status and the numbers of
# signature verifications and of NSEC3 hash computations of its validation, and for a status that
# breaks the test's oracle how it does (the classes are listed at judge in
# universe_helpers_test.go) and a tag naming what will fix that. Both numbers depend on the order
# of the cases where cases share a validator (see run): a case does not query for the DS and DNSKEY
# RRsets of zones that an earlier case left in the validator's cache, so it makes none of the
# verifications and hashes for those replies. Running the test with -update-golden rewrites the
# case lines; these comments and the tags are kept by hand.
#
# Tags:
#   deferred:#2397            Signed data for large RSA exponents is put in the wrong order (#2397).
#
# A deferred tag is only for a reply that is refused and should not be.
